## Psoriasis codelist — CPRD Read codes

Includes psoriasis diagnoses, recognised variants, and psoriatic arthropathy. Codes and descriptions are reproduced as returned by the CPRD searches.

### Condition-specific codes

| Read code | Description |

| M16y0 | Scalp psoriasis |
| Myu30 | [X]Other psoriasis |
| N0452 | Juvenile arthritis in psoriasis |
| Nyu13 | Psoriasis with arthropathy |

**Interpretation notes:** `M1602` is included because it is classified under psoriatic arthropathy in the Read hierarchy, although arthritis mutilans can occur in other diseases. Psoriatic arthropathy codes identify psoriatic disease but do not necessarily establish currently active skin lesions.

### Additional codes for a broader case definition

These should remain distinguishable from condition-specific diagnoses.

| Read code | Description | Qualification |
|---|---|---|
| M16 | Psoriasis and similar disorders | Broad category that can include non-psoriasis disorders; not definitive alone |
| M16z | Psoriasis and similar disorders NOS | Broad category; not definitive alone |
| 38Gg | Psoriasis area and severity index score | Supports psoriasis assessment or monitoring, but is not itself a diagnosis and may record a score of zero |

**Excluded:** family-history codes (`12H2`, `12H5`), history-only code (`14F2`), parapsoriasis and its variants, and other non-psoriasis disorders within the `M16` hierarchy, such as pityriasis rosea and pityriasis rubra pilaris.

A diagnosis code indicates psoriasis at the recorded encounter; it does not, without a time-based case definition, establish that the condition remains active at a later date.

### Broader codes — optional for a sensitivity-oriented definition

These codes explicitly encompass “similar disorders”, so they do **not** establish psoriasis specifically. Keep them separate from the primary codelist.

| M16z | Psoriasis and similar disorders NOS |

### Exclusions

| Code or group | Reason |
|---|---|
| 12H2 — FH: Psoriasis | Family history, not the patient's diagnosis |
| 12H5 — Family history of psoriasis with arthropathy | Family history |
| 14F2 — H/O: psoriasis | Historical disease; does not establish current disease |
| 38Gg — Psoriasis area and severity index score | Assessment code rather than a diagnosis; a recorded score alone does not establish current disease |
| M162 and all descendants; Myu31 | Parapsoriasis and related conditions are distinct from psoriasis |
| Other non-psoriasis descendants of M16 | Includes pityriasis and other disorders; excluded despite sharing the parent hierarchy |

A diagnostic code indicates psoriasis **at the time it was recorded**; defining current psoriasis at a later study date also requires a temporal rule.
